name: Gay Marriages
overview: Scripture clearly defines marriage as a union between a man and a woman, as established in Genesis 2:24 where a man cleaves to his wife to become one flesh. The Old Testament explicitly condemns sexual relations between men as an abomination in Leviticus 18:22 and 20:13. The New Testament reinforces this by describing such actions as contrary to natural use in Romans 1:26. While the law calls for love toward others, as emphasized in Romans 13:8 and Galatians 5:14, biblical love does not alter the clear moral boundaries set regarding marriage and sexual behavior.
